policy_presence.summary: MIT publishes official AI guidance and tool restrictions; this does not establish a single Institute-wide classroom AI-use policy.

ai_disclosure.summary: MIT Libraries provides citation and acknowledgment guidance. Applicable class and publication requirements may differ; no universal mandatory disclosure rule is established here.

coursework.summary: Course-specific policies determine assessment permission. The faculty guidance does not establish a universal coursework permission or prohibition.

exams.summary: No universal exam permission or prohibition is established by this reviewed record. Follow the actual exam instructions; tool access is not exam permission.

privacy_data_entry.summary: Public GenAI must not receive Medium Risk MIT data. No GenAI tool may receive High Risk MIT data; public tools are not recommended for Low Risk MIT data.

academic_integrity.summary: The committee describes COD detector-evidence limits; general COD return conditions are not AI-specific penalties. These sources do not establish automatic AI sanctions.

approved_tools.summary: MIT-licensed tools have eligibility and data conditions. Their institutional approval is separate from permission for a class or assessment.

named_ai_services.summary: The official directory names ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Parley and other services. Use the tool records for current institutional access and data conditions; assessment permission is separate.

teaching_guidance.summary: Instructors are encouraged to state clear course policies. TLL strongly recommends against AI detection tools; this is guidance rather than an Institute-wide detector ban.

research_guidance.summary: The committee recommends thesis AI-use statements; applicable COUHES applications have mandatory Data Card and consent requirements. These distinct scopes must not be collapsed into one universal research rule.

security_procurement.summary: Purchasing a new GenAI tool requires VPF procurement. Request assessment before using or purchasing a tool not on the IS&T list.
